question: Where do the varied cycles of transmigration actually occur?
premises: The being repeatedly takes varied world-cycles to be real.
This taking-to-be-real is driven by dwelling in one's own impressions and tendencies.
The conscious subject in whom this occurs is Śiva.
inference: The varied cycles of transmigration occur in the one conscious locus, Śiva, as experiences shaped by impressions.
plain_english: Again and again, Śiva, dwelling in his own impressions and tendencies, takes varied worlds of transmigration to be real, all in one and the same place.
